scope: Main menu Credits entry: original MenuCredits world request, custom game type, the END/CREDITS roll flag, the CCredits/CCredit text roll from cres.dll TEXT/CREDITS and the in-world GS_CREDITS screen; no renderer or font code imported

references.purpose: MenuCredits: outside a world StartNewGame("Credits", STARTGAME_NORMAL, GAMETYPE_CUSTOM, LOADTYPE_NEW_GAME, DIFFICULTY_MEDIUM) without SetCharacterInfo; inside a world Term + Init(CM_CREDITS, clear) + PauseGame + GS_CREDITS. PreLoadWorld sets m_bRollCredits for END/CREDITS and Terms m_Credits; GS_PLAYING Inits the roll with bClearScreen FALSE and updates it, then updates it again after RenderCamera ([blg]); OnKeyDown sends every key to the roll outside GS_CREDITS; GS_CREDITS Esc Terms and returns to play, other keys go to HandleInput; OnExitWorld Terms.

CCredit/CCredits ported to game/original/Credits.cpp: ## blocks, >END, >TIME: with atof, line splitting, MAX_CREDIT_STRINGS 12 / MAX_CREDITS 256, SetStaticInfo font size and CM_CREDITS 4 s / 2 s defaults, state machine (0.5 s fade-in, hold, 0.4 s fade-out with the 0.1 floor when not clearing, hold-out), speed/pause/advance keys, endless wrap, Draw/DrawString centering and SetupColor1 red ramp.
Constants (MAX_CREDIT_STRINGS, MAX_CREDITS, speed limits, CS_/CM_ values), IncSpeed/DecSpeed and Clear/GetCredit inlines.
FindResource(cres_hinstance, "CREDITS", "TEXT"): replaced by the data-only read_named_resource PE reader on the mounted cres.dll.
TypeCustom/OPT_FLAG_CUSTOM filtering applies to GAMETYPE_CUSTOM worlds; the existing port is unchanged.

adaptations: The world name test runs at player entry on the normalized world path instead of in PreLoadWorld.
GAMETYPE_CUSTOM is accepted only for fresh NEW_GAME requests; NEW_LEVEL, saves and multiplayer types still refuse explicitly.
Credits strings are owned std::string copies; the static speed, pause, hold defaults and font request are members of the CCredits owner in the client shell instead of globals.
The resource is read as data through a bounded PE reader: one language only, ASCII names, 1 MiB payload; text ends at the resource size or the first NUL.

The original 256-byte line and 1024-byte block buffers overflowed silently; longer text is an explicit failure leaving an inited, empty roll. A missing resource is also reported instead of silently showing nothing.
The roll update (Init then two Update calls per frame) runs in the session step after the client shell update; the GS_CREDITS screen updates once per frontend frame with the clamped frame delta.

Drawing uses the 640x480 menu viewport (font size chosen for a 640-pixel screen) and Dear ImGui's embedded default font at 22 virtual pixels instead of the GDI Arial 14x22 font; the requested face and size are recorded. Text bytes are shown as Latin-1.
A zero 8-bit red channel draws nothing (the original black transparent key / black-on-black).
